summary: Backend testing of MyFinance complete. 18/18 pytest tests passed covering auth (register/login/me), default seed (4 buckets + budget), expenses CRUD, debts + payment lifecycle (partial, full payoff, paid list), budget upsert, buckets CRUD, multi-tenancy isolation, and 401 on missing auth. All endpoints behave per spec.

minor.issue: Returns 200 {ok:true} even when the id belongs to another user or doesn't exist. No 404 on cross-user delete. Isolation still holds (the delete does nothing because of user_id scoping), but API leaks no signal and is not idempotent-safe. Consider returning 404 when deleted_count == 0.
Overpayments are silently clamped to remaining=0 (max(0, remaining-amount)). Not a bug per spec ('when payment >= remaining'), but there's no validation preventing negative or zero amounts.
Returns the request body instead of the persisted document. Works fine because upsert matches, but could mislead clients. GET shows correct value.
Uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'). Consider migrating to lifespan context for future FastAPI compatibility.

action_items: (Optional) Return 404 from DELETE endpoints when nothing was deleted to surface cross-user / invalid-id errors.
(Optional) Validate PaymentIn.amount > 0 and reject payments on already-paid debts.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 289-line file — acceptable, under 700 LOC threshold, no split needed yet.
All DB/IO uses async motor — good.
MongoDB _id excluded via projections everywhere — good.
Env vars used with os.environ[...] and fail fast if missing — good. JWT_SECRET not hardcoded.
Pydantic models with Literal enums validate freq inputs correctly — good.
bcrypt hashing with gensalt, JWT HS256 with 30-day expiry — standard and correct.
CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=False — fine because Bearer auth (not cookies).
Minor: log_payment doesn't return 404 when fully paid debt gets another payment — could double-log on already-paid debts.
test_credentials: Fresh users registered per-run via testuser+<ts>@example.com / password123. Shared test account demo.user@myfinance.test / password123 documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: Each test run creates 2 fresh users (A, B) via /api/auth/register. Associated seed data (4 buckets + 1 budget) auto-created by backend. Test creates/deletes scoped expenses, debts, buckets. No production data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_myfinance_api.py is idempotent (uses timestamped emails) and can be re-run any time. Only minor non-blocking suggestions remain. Frontend was not tested (backend-only request). Playbook auth checks (bcrypt $2b$, JWT, brute-force lockout) — bcrypt is $2b$, JWT works, but there is NO brute-force lockout implemented (not required by request but flag if spec demands it). No httpOnly cookies — this app uses Bearer token in localStorage per /app/memory/test_credentials.md which is by design.
